validation_scope: Exact conservation and TEI P5 schema validity for one complete retained A61580 TEI P5 witness representing one top-level titled monographic work.
acceptance: A successful technical validation is a nonaccepted candidate only. It does not change WorkCatalog acceptance, rights review, or publication authorization.

required: Candidate content.tei.xml is byte-identical to the exact retained A61580.xml source.
The document is well-formed TEI P5 and validates against the pinned OCD TEI all.xsd.
Exactly one TEI root and one monographic title hierarchy are present.
The source title page, three internal books, 22 chapters, page anchors, notes, verse, character references, and source-declared gaps remain conserved by byte identity.
comparison.known_limit: Byte identity demonstrates source conservation, not accuracy against page images. Image collation and human editorial acceptance remain separate and open.

mutation_challenges: Alter body wording while retaining valid XML and resealing package membership; require rejection for source-byte and body-text mismatch.
Alter a chapter heading while retaining valid XML and resealing package membership; require rejection for source-byte and division-text mismatch.
Alter a note attachment while retaining valid XML and resealing package membership; require rejection for source-byte and note-attachment mismatch.
reproduction: Reconstruct and independently validate in two fresh Python processes; baseline package and validation report hashes must match exactly.
